name: Chief of Staff (S4MU)
tagline: A creator's coordinator: comment research packs plus a daily junk sweep
description: Built around the reality of running a channel. It bundles YouTube-comment reports summarised in Italian and English and read through research, advisory and resolution angles, with a daily pass over an Outlook inbox for junk. Nothing is removed without asking, so the sweep stays reviewable.
author: Spiderjin
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
